provenance.*.translation: preserve original legal metadata; optional localized presentation
provenance.*.rule: Original publisher URL, record ID, revision, history, content digest, licence and attribution stay attached

countries.translation: localized country label on referenced resource
countries.rule: Meaning is source-kind specific; never infer origin from language, source office or barcode prefix

data.name|data.foodName|data.title|data..translation: any supported locale, with original text hash and provenance
data.name|data.foodName|data.title|data..rule: Names alone never establish identical food, product or recipe identity

data.identifiers.rule: Namespace, issuer, checksum, scope and dates retained; unreviewed identifiers stay source-scoped

data.basis.datatype: quantity with denominator, unit and preparation state
data.basis.rule: 100 g, 100 ml, serving, whole-food and component bases remain distinct

data.nutrients.*.rule: Preserve source component definition, value/unknown/trace/limit, unit, method, denominator and state; generic nutrient names do not prove method equivalence

data.price|data.amount|data.currency|dat.rule: Retain observation date, market, package/basis and currency; no unrecorded exchange conversion

data.ingredients.*.translation: shared ingredient labels and original/translated source wording separately
data.ingredients.*.rule: Keep preparation, alternatives, optionality, unresolved match, source measures/ranges and scaling rules

data.directions|data.directionsByLanguag.translation: whole instruction semantics with source text hash
data.directions|data.directionsByLanguag.rule: A different-language variant is not a translation of identical instructions unless supported by source evidence

data.yield.rule: Unknown yield stays unknown; source batch and edible/served/eaten portions are not conflated

data.roles|data.locations|data.countryBa.rule: Do not promote name/candidate relationships into verified ownership or stock availability

data.sourceCulture|data.nativeName|data..rule: Preserve edition, adaptation language and cultural/source context without forcing a national recipe identity

private inventory quantity/location/prep.translation: display only; stable identifiers and account scope unchanged
private inventory quantity/location/prep.rule: Never publish private inventory by linking a public ingredient/product

*unmapped*.translation: display text carries explicit language or und; identifiers stay fixed
*unmapped*.rule: Preserve new source values and their paths/citations; propose semantic mappings instead of dropping or relabelling them
